command:start=$(git log --format='%H %s' | awk '$2 == "gnomish:" && $3 == "task" && $4 == "started" { print $1; exit }'); base=$(git rev-parse "$start^" 2>/dev/null || git merge-base HEAD origin/main 2>/dev/null) || { echo "cannot tell where this task branch started: no 'gnomish: task started' commit and no origin/main"; exit 1; }; oversized=$({ git diff --name-only --diff-filter=AM "$base" -- packages/client/src; git ls-files -o --exclude-standard packages/client/src; } | sort -u | while read -r file; do [ -f "$file" ] && lines=$(wc -l < "$file") && [ "$lines" -gt 300 ] && echo "$file: $lines lines"; done); [ -z "$oversized" ] || { echo "$oversized"; echo "these files exceed the 300-line hard cap - split them, see .claude/rules/process-invariants.md"; exit 1; }

command:. .gnomish/lib/task-change.sh
since=$(git log --format='%H %s' | awk '$2 == "gnomish:" && $3 == "round" && $4 !~ /^implement#/ { print $1; exit }')
start=$(git log --format='%H %s' | awk '$2 == "gnomish:" && $3 == "task" && $4 == "started" { print $1; exit }')
[ -n "$since" ] || since=$(git rev-parse "$start^" 2>/dev/null || git merge-base HEAD origin/main)
changed=$({ git diff --name-only "$since"; git ls-files -o --exclude-standard; } | sort -u | grep -v '^\.gnomish-task/' || true)
forbidden=$(printf '%s\n' "$changed" | grep -E '^(openspec/|temporary-docs/|\.gnomish/|\.github/|\.claude/|docs/adr/|CLAUDE\.md$)' | grep -vxF "$change/tasks.md" | grep -v "^$reports/handoff/" || true)
[ -z "$forbidden" ] || { echo "$forbidden"; echo "the implement stage edits only packages/, docs/ outside docs/adr/, the checkboxes of $change/tasks.md and $reports/handoff/ - put changes to these paths into a handoff patch (see .gnomish/stages/specify/handoff.md) and restore the files above with: git checkout $since -- <file>"; exit 1; }
dependencies=$(printf '%s\n' "$changed" | grep -E '(^|/)(package\.json|pnpm-lock\.yaml)$' || true)
if [ -n "$dependencies" ] && ! grep -qiE 'pnpm add|dependenc|package\.json' "$change/tasks.md"; then echo "$dependencies"; echo "tasks.md asks for no dependency or package.json change - restore the files above with: git checkout $since -- <file>"; exit 1; fi

command:. .gnomish/lib/task-change.sh
for patch in "$reports"/handoff/*.patch; do
  [ -e "$patch" ] || continue
  git apply --check "$patch" || { echo "$patch does not apply to the branch - regenerate it as .gnomish/stages/specify/handoff.md describes"; exit 1; }
done
if grep -qE '^- H[0-9]+' "$change/tasks.md" && [ ! -f "$reports/handoff/README.md" ]; then
  echo "tasks.md lists handoff items under Human follow-up but $reports/handoff/README.md is missing"; exit 1
fi

findings.message: Missing Gherkin scenario for the unix-time-converter delta scenario 'A second view shows the same moment' (spec.md: 'GIVEN a test registry whose first view is a test view / WHEN the user opens the converter and the test view sends the text `1795432987123` / THEN the test view receives the Moscow row with the time «14:23:07.123»', FR17). No .feature under packages/client/src/test/features has it, but task 9.6 (ticked) requires 'every scenario of the unix-time-converter delta not listed in 8.5 or 9.8'. Only the Vitest UnixTimeConverterPage.test.tsx covers it. Add it with @add-unix-time-converter-tool @FR17 to unix_time_converter_unit.feature (or a sibling) with step definitions.

Missing Gherkin scenario for the tools delta scenario 'The tool is turned off in another tab' (Requirement 'Open and leave a tool page', FR5). Task 4.6 (ticked) requires 'every scenario of "Open and leave a tool page" (@FR5 @NFR-A2)' in tools_e2e.feature, but no feature file has it. Only AppShell.tools.test.tsx covers it.

tools_e2e.feature lacks 'Another tab turns a tool on' (@FR3). Task 4.6 lists '"Enabled tools are kept on the device" → "Enabled tools survive a reload" and "Another tab turns a tool on"' for the E2E feature, but the scenario exists only in tools_preferences_unit.feature.

Missing E2E scenario for the settings delta 'Toggle group' → 'Icon options' on the tools group (@FR2 @NFR-A1), which task 4.6 requires. No feature under src/test/features/settings or src/test/features/tools contains it. The existing 'Icons only, in the order System, Light, Dark' covers the theme group, not the tools group.

Layering: src/views/unixTimeConverter/list/UnitChoice.tsx:2 does `import type { UnixTimeUnitChoice } from "@/model/unixTime"` and casts `event.target.value as UnixTimeUnitChoice` at line 28. design.md D9 says a converter view 'renders presenter output, emits commands and imports nothing from `model/`'. Expose the choice type from the presenter (PresentedUnitOption.choice) or the ConverterCommands type, and import it from there.

Test helper placed in production views: src/views/unixTimeConverter/list/renderConverterView.tsx imports @testing-library/react, the in-memory adapters and @/test factories, and carries a '// Verifies …' header, yet it lives in the production views folder. Project test helpers of this kind live under src/test/ (e.g. src/test/renderViewLocationList.tsx). Move it there.
